cover_title: The one rule behind every gain

slides.heading: Do a little more over time
slides.body: Muscles grow when you give them a reason to adapt. Add a rep, a bit of weight, or an extra set as weeks go by.

slides.heading: Pick one lever at a time
slides.body: Weight, reps, sets or slower tempo. Change one per session so you know what is working and stay in control.

slides.heading: Track every workout
slides.body: If you do not know what you lifted last week, you cannot beat it. Log your weights and reps every session.

slides.heading: Small steps, big results
slides.body: Even 1 extra rep each week adds up over months. Progress should feel steady, not heroic. Rest when you need it.

caption:
Want to get stronger? Do a little more than last time.

That is progressive overload, the simple idea behind almost every strength and muscle gain. Add a rep, add a little weight, or add a set, and do it consistently. Track your sessions so you always know what to beat next, and take recovery seriously.
